scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof is supplied; code offers supplementary high-precision tests and is not an independent proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the real unweighted two-mode exponential L2 projector on a single unit interval; no claim of minimal projection norm, all-rate dominance of one endpoint, or extension to arbitrary knots or exponent collections. Older specialized literature may contain equivalent results.
title: Sharp endpoint norms and a logarithmic boundary layer for exponential least-squares projection
